EmailTemplate.subject: EverQuote Resource Library for Insurance Agents!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Lead.FirstName},
Hope all is well and you're gearing up for a huge rest of 2020! I wanted to share with you some of the amazing videos, webinars, eBooks and articles that EverQuote has published in our on-going efforts to become your "go-to" source for insurance agent-focused content.
Videos: Visit EverQuote’s Vimeo page (https://vimeo.com/everquotepro) for new video content including best practice videos, testimonials and webinar recordings. Here are a few examples of what’s available: - EverQuote Best Practices: Overcoming Objections (https://vimeo.com/386289088): join EverQuote Senior Customer Success Manager Randi Alvarado as she walks you through how to overcome common objections that arise when working insurance leads - Ted Todd Insurance – EverQuote Testimonial (https://vimeo.com/351046153) - EverQuote Pro Platform: Tips & Best Practice Guide (https://vimeo.com/386291524): EverQuote Business Consultant Todd Badolato walks you through the EverQuote Pro platform, sharing tips and best practices to help set you up for success. - Webinar: “Developing Team Members into Rock Stars” with Heather Powell (https://vimeo.com/393784983): Top agent Heather Powell describes her process for recruiting (and retaining) top talent and some of the major lessons she’s learned along the way.
eBooks: You can find a range of valuable content on our Resources page (https://resources.everquote.com/), where we regularly publish new eBooks, white papers and guides. - EverQuote Sales Best Practices (https://go.everquote.com/sales-best-practices) – use this guide to help align your sales processes with what the data shows are the most effective ways to work inbound insurance leads and warm transfer calls - 10 Things Every Agent Should Be Doing (But That Most Aren't) (https://go.everquote.com/10-things-every-agent-should-be-doing) – use this guide to help align your sales and agency management processes with what top insurance agents are already doing - 4 Example Scripts To Help You Handle Consumer Objections (https://go.everquote.com/4-example-scripts-to-help-you-handle-consumer-objections) – use this guide to help you address four common objections agents face on insurance sales calls - The Ultimate Social Media Playbook For Insurance Agents (https://go.everquote.com/social-media-playbook-for-insurance-agents) – Learn how to implement a proven, effective social media marketing strategy for your agency in this free playbook.
Blog: Visit the EverQuote blog (https://learn.everquote.com/) for regularly updated, agent-focused content, including articles like: - “I never asked for a quote!” How to Turn Around Negative Sales Conversations & Insurance Lead Objections (https://learn.everquote.com/insurance-lead-objections) - How To Sell Insurance When Your Carrier's Rates Are High (https://learn.everquote.com/insurance-sales-tips) - Six Insurance Agents Share Their Worst Mistakes (https://learn.everquote.com/insurance-agent-mistakes) - 12 Customer Retention Strategies In The Insurance Industry (https://learn.everquote.com/customer-retention-in-insurance-industry)
Please don’t hesitate to reach out directly if you have any questions – (844) 707-8800. Best,
Chris
Chris Nashed Director, Inside Sales sales@everquote.com
